summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on debugging and optimizing a function (`getFrequency`) within a data analytics context, specifically addressing issues related to short-circuit evaluation in ClickHouse (CH).

Initially, an attempt was made to force the use of `short circuit evaluation` for a multiIf statement using a dedicated setting. While this worked on a truncated test query, it failed when run against the full dataset.

Ultimately, the function needed significant refactoring: it was split into three separate functions, each containing nested internal functions. This structural change ensured that the machine learning API (`ml-api`) would be called no more than once per invocation, regardless of the execution path or data structure complexity.
decisions: The `getFrequency` function was restructured into three separate components to limit `ml-api` calls.
